Bill.BriefDescription: Studying public fund investment policies and practices.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying public fund investment policies andpractices; creating new sections; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that state and localgovernments across the country are experiencing serious budgetshortfalls. The legislature further finds that many of thesegovernments entered into contracts for highrisk derivatives deals withtermination clauses that left these governments with large fees owed tofinancial institutions, further exacerbating their fiscal problems.The legislature intends to determine whether state and localgovernments in Washington state entered into these kinds of contractsand examine ways to avoid the problems encountered by othergovernments.

By December 1, 2010, the state investmentboard, in consultation and cooperation with the state treasurer andrelevant cities and counties, shall submit a report to the appropriatecommittees of the legislature on the following: p. 1 HB 3151 (1) A survey of current investment policies and practices by stateand local governments and limits in place to avoid highrisk and exoticinvestment instruments; (2) An identification of any governmental entities that could beliable for large fees owed to financial institutions due to terminationclauses in contracts for derivatives deals; and (3) Recommendations for legislative and policy changes to preventstate and local governments from making highrisk investments.
